channel.title: Pier & Point · 409/499 Illinois Street
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for 409/499 Illinois Street (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · 409/499 Illinois Street: This record was named '490/499 Illinois Street' and also described UCSF's Valley Center for Vision at 490 Illinois St, which is the block 33 building across Illinois St (see that record). The City's address points show its two buildings are 499 Illinois St (south) and 409 Illinois St (north), so it is renamed '409/499 Illinois Street' and the Vision Center's facts moved to the block 33 record. Its old page address redirects to the new one.

item.title: Correction · 409/499 Illinois Street: A September note on the 490/499 Illinois record wrongly said a cited SF Standard article doesn't support UCSF leasing 499 Illinois for over a decade; it does, and the note was corrected.

Source: https://sfstandard.com/2025/12/17/ucsf-drops-767-million-expand-its-mission-bay-campus/.

item.title: Correction · 409/499 Illinois Street: The record no longer says 499 Illinois is about 450,000 sq ft (SGH gives a 500,000 sq ft center in two buildings; SF Standard gives 470,000 sq ft for 409 and 499 together), calls the 490 Illinois buildings separate rather than connected as SF YIMBY says, cites the 2006 DBI permit for six stories, and no longer names Alexandria as developer (a 2013 Alexandria release and SF Standard show ownership only) or the 490 building's developer as UCSF (SF YIMBY says only that it opened for UCSF). The Vision Center's November 2020 opening is now stated as SF YIMBY's report on November 27, 2020, without a stated opening day. The map label no longer uses the name 'Alexandria Center for Science and Technology', which no cited source uses for 499 Illinois. UCSF's lease and purchase at 499 Illinois is now cited to SF Standard (Dec 2025) and the reproductive health clinic to UCSF Health's location page. A dated note on the map shape records that OpenStreetMap labels the two buildings the opposite way round from this map and that DataSF parcels show a 409/499 pairing; which footprint is 490 Illinois remains unresolved. The Wikimedia photo credit no longer names an author or a flight the file page does not state.

item.title: Added · 409/499 Illinois Street: UC Regents bought 409 Illinois St and 499 Illinois St together from Alexandria Real Estate Equities for $767,000,000 (closed 2025-12-17), and is renovating 409 Illinois St (261,117 sq ft) into a new School of Dentistry and Interprofessional Education Center with Suffolk and CO Architects, targeted to open in late 2029.
item.description: UC Regents bought 409 Illinois St and 499 Illinois St together from Alexandria Real Estate Equities for $767,000,000 (closed 2025-12-17), and is renovating 409 Illinois St (261,117 sq ft) into a new School of Dentistry and Interprofessional Education Center with Suffolk and CO Architects, targeted to open in late 2029. Source: https://sfstandard.com/2025/12/17/ucsf-drops-767-million-expand-its-mission-bay-campus/.

item.title: Added · 409/499 Illinois Street: Caffe Central (490 Illinois St; SF YIMBY, 2020-11-27, places UCSF's Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision at 490 Illinois Street) had been missing and was added, confirmed via the cafe's own site, which publishes this exact address as a location. No opening date found (SF YIMBY reported the building open by Nov 27, 2020, so the cafe can't predate that). It is assigned to the 490-499 Illinois St record, whose sourced address is 490 Illinois St, not the neighboring UCSF Valley Center for Vision (west) record, a separate building about 60-100 m away across the street with an unresolved naming question. DataSF business registrations show no listing for Caffe Central at this address (only one at 460 16th St, presumably a different location of the same small chain), so, like Standard Deviant Brewing, it was a real tenant missing from the registration data.

item.title: Milestone · 409/499 Illinois Street: The University of California (UC Regents) buys 409 Illinois St and 499 Illinois St together from Alexandria Real Estate Equities for $767,000,000: approximately 525,421 rentable sq ft on 3.6 acres with a 587-space shared garage. UC's own CEQA Notice of Exemption for the acquisition (Class 1, Existing Facilities) was posted the next day. (Dec 17, 2025)
